title: 送布机构
The Feed Mechanism
goals: 能用两个简谐运动写出送布牙齿尖的轨迹，算出牙露出针板的抓布区间 2α 和每针送布量 s = (S/2)(1 − cos 2α)。
Write the feed-dog tooth-tip trajectory as two harmonic motions, and calculate the gripping interval 2α and the feed per stitch s = (S/2)(1 − cos 2α).
能把送布时序与机针运动放在同一转角轴上，判断布是否在机针入布后还被推动，并说明标准送布定时的检查方法。
Put the feed timing and the needle motion on one angle axis, judge whether the fabric is pushed after the needle enters, and explain how the standard feed timing is checked.
能用针距调节器原理 S = 2e·i·tanθ 计算导杆倾角和倒缝，算出送布牙的最大速度和加速度。
Use the stitch-regulator principle S = 2e·i·tanθ to find the guide tilt and reverse feed, and calculate the dog’s maximum velocity and acceleration.
能解释牙高、压脚压力对抓布和定时的影响，以及下送布上下层错位的两难，并比较针送布、综合送布、上送布的解决办法。
Explain how feed-dog height and presser-foot pressure affect gripping and timing, the ply-shift dilemma of drop feed, and how needle, compound and top feed solve it.

title: 牛仔裤腰头上断针
Broken needles on jeans waistbands
text: 某牛仔裤厂缝腰头，四层牛仔布约 4 mm 厚，针距 3 mm。机器是按使用说明书的标准送布定时调的（送布牙落下时牙面与针眼上沿同时与针板齐平），在缝 1.5 mm 的薄料时一直正常。可一缝腰头，机针就被布带歪，时有断针。算例机：针杆曲柄 r = 15.5 mm、连杆 55 mm，针尖在上止点时高出针板 18 mm；抬牙幅值 A = 1.1 mm，牙高 0.8 mm，标准定时下牙在 114.2° 落下。

A jeans factory is sewing waistbands: four plies of denim, about 4 mm thick, stitch length 3 mm. The machine is set to the manual’s standard feed timing (as the dog drops, its face and the top of the needle eye become flush with the throat plate together), and it has always been fine on 1.5 mm fabric. But on the waistband the needle is dragged sideways and breaks from time to time. Worked-example machine: needle-bar crank r = 15.5 mm, connecting rod 55 mm, needle point 18 mm above the plate at top dead centre; lift amplitude A = 1.1 mm, feed-dog height 0.8 mm; with standard timing the dog drops at 114.2°.
question: 针尖在什么转角刺入 4 mm 厚的布？按标准定时，布在机针入布以后还被推动多少？送布定时应该怎样调、调多少？要缝 3 mm 针距，牙的水平行程要多大？

At what shaft angle does the needle point enter 4 mm of fabric? With standard timing, how far is the fabric pushed after the needle enters? How should the feed timing be changed, and by how much? What horizontal dog stroke is needed for a 3 mm stitch?
answer: 由第 3 章的曲柄滑块公式，针尖下到布面（高出针板 4 mm）在约 92.7°，比 1.5 mm 薄料（101.7°）早 9°。牙到 114.2° 才落下，这 21.5° 里布在针中又被推了约 0.11 mm，超出 0.05 mm 的允许值，机针被带弯而断。把送布定时（水平和抬牙一起）提前约 8°，落牙提前到 106.2°，布在针中的移动降到约 0.045 mm；若只提前水平运动 8°，还剩约 0.06 mm 并出现少量回拖，所以要两个运动一起提前。抓布区间 2α = 2 arccos(0.3/1.1) = 148.3°，送布效率 0.926，3 mm 针距需要牙行程 3.24 mm。

From the Chapter 3 slider-crank formula, the needle point reaches the fabric surface (4 mm above the plate) at about 92.7°, 9° earlier than for 1.5 mm fabric (101.7°). The dog does not drop until 114.2°, and during those 21.5° the fabric is pushed about 0.11 mm with the needle in it — above the 0.05 mm allowance — so the needle bends and breaks. Advancing the feed timing (horizontal and lift together) by about 8° brings the drop forward to 106.2° and the movement down to about 0.045 mm; advancing only the horizontal motion by 8° leaves about 0.06 mm plus a little back-drag, so both must move together. The gripping interval is 2α = 2 arccos(0.3/1.1) = 148.3°, the feed efficiency 0.926, so a 3 mm stitch needs a dog stroke of 3.24 mm.

title: 送布牙轨迹 ↔ 步行机器人的足端轨迹
Feed-dog trajectory ↔ the foot trajectory of a walking robot
text: 送布牙的四动作和步行机器人一条腿的步态是同一回事：足端着地（支撑相）时向后蹬，推动机身前进；抬起（摆动相）后在空中收回。足端轨迹由髋关节的水平摆动和膝关节的抬落两路运动合成，正像送布牙由送布偏心轮和抬牙偏心轮合成一个椭圆。机身每步前进的距离不是足端的全部水平行程，而只是着地那一段的水平位移，对应 s = X(落) − X(升)。两个关节的相位差设错了，足端着地后还在往回走，脚就在地面上打滑，这就是送布的“回拖”；电子送布（第 14 章）用伺服或步进电机直接驱动牙的水平运动，和机器人用两台伺服按程序设定相位是同一个思路。

The four motions of the feed dog are the gait of one robot leg: in stance the foot is on the ground and pushes back, moving the body forward; in swing it lifts and returns through the air. The foot path is the sum of the hip’s horizontal swing and the knee’s lift, just as the feed dog combines the feed eccentric and the lift eccentric into an ellipse. The body advances not by the foot’s whole horizontal stroke but only by its horizontal travel while on the ground, which corresponds to s = X(drop) − X(rise). Set the phase between the two joints wrong and the foot is still moving back after touch-down, so it slips on the ground — the same as “back-drag” in feeding. Electronic feed (Chapter 14) drives the dog’s horizontal motion directly with a servo or stepper, the same idea as a robot leg whose two servos follow a programmed phase.

title: 划船的桨
Rowing an oar
text: 划船时桨叶只在入水到出水这一段推船前进，出水后在空中收回，不碰水；如果出水太晚，桨叶在水里往回带，船反而被拖慢。这和送布牙只在露出针板时推布、落牙太晚就回拖一模一样。

When rowing, the blade drives the boat only between the catch and the release, then returns through the air without touching the water; release too late and the blade drags back in the water and slows the boat. That is exactly how the feed dog pushes only while above the plate, and back-drags if it drops too late.

title: 引子：三个出在送布上的毛病
Opening: three faults that come from the feed
points: 针距不匀：同样刻度，针有长有短，厚薄交替处最明显。
Uneven stitch length: same dial, some stitches long and some short, worst where thick and thin alternate.
上层越缝越长：两片等长裁片，缝完上层多出一截；衬里、丝绸、针织最明显。
The upper ply grows: two equal pieces, the upper one sticks out at the end; worst on linings, silk and knits.
厚料断针：牛仔腰头、裤袢，机针被布带歪撞上旋梭。
Needle breakage on heavy work: on jeans waistbands and belt loops the needle is dragged into the hook.
归结为两个问题：布什么时候动、动多少；上下两层是否一起动。
Two questions underlie them: when and how far the fabric moves, and whether both plies move together.
narration: 今天讲送布。先看车间里三个毛病，修机师傅一看到它们就会先查送布。第一个是针距不匀，同样的刻度，有的针长有的针短，厚薄交替的地方最明显。第二个是两层布缝完，上层多出一截，衬里、丝绸、针织布上特别常见。第三个是缝牛仔裤腰头、裤袢的时候断针，机针被布带歪了撞上旋梭。这三个毛病原因不同，但都归结到两个问题：布在什么时候动、动了多少；上层和下层是不是一起动。这一讲就围绕这两个问题展开，最后我们会算出牛仔腰头断针的原因和调法。

Today’s topic is the feed. Start with three shop-floor faults that send a mechanic straight to the feed. First, uneven stitch length: at the same dial setting some stitches are long and some short, especially where thick and thin sections alternate. Second, after two plies are sewn the upper one sticks out at the end — very common on linings, silk and knits. Third, broken needles on jeans waistbands and belt loops: the needle is dragged sideways and hits the hook. The causes differ, but they come down to two questions: when does the fabric move and by how much, and do the upper and lower plies move together? This lesson is built around those two questions, and at the end we will work out why the waistband needle breaks and how to fix it.

title: 送布的任务：四动作
The task of feeding: four motions
points: 威尔逊 1854 年的四动作送布：升 → 进 → 降 → 退，今天仍是如此。
Wilson’s 1854 four-motion feed — rise, advance, drop, return — is still used today.
“升”“降”决定何时抓布、放布；“进”“退”决定推多远。
Rise and drop decide when the fabric is gripped and released; advance and return decide how far.
只有牙在针板上面的那段“进”才推动布；在针板下面的“退”不碰布。
Only the advance above the throat plate moves the fabric; the return below it does not touch it.
布夹在压脚、针板、送布牙之间：送布好坏取决于牙的运动、牙高、压脚压力和面料。
The fabric is held between foot, plate and dog: feeding depends on dog motion, dog height, foot pressure and the fabric.
narration: 送布机构要做的事，在 1854 年就被威尔逊定下来了，叫四动作送布：送布牙先升起顶住布，再往前带着布走，然后降到针板下面，最后退回原位。升和降决定什么时候抓住布、什么时候放开；进和退决定推多远。关键一句话：只有牙在针板上面的那一段前进，才真正推动布；在针板下面往回退的时候不碰布，所以布不会被带回来。布是被夹在三样东西中间的：上面压脚压着，下面针板托着，送布牙从针板槽里冒出来咬住布。所以送得好不好，不光看牙怎么动，还要看牙高、压脚压力和面料本身。

What the feed mechanism must do was settled by Wilson in 1854 — the four-motion feed: the dog rises to grip the fabric, advances carrying it forward, drops below the throat plate, and returns to its starting point. Rise and drop decide when the fabric is gripped and released; advance and return decide how far it goes. The key sentence: only the part of the advance that happens above the plate actually moves the fabric; the return happens below the plate without touching it, so the fabric is not carried back. The fabric is held between three things: the presser foot on top, the throat plate below, and the dog coming up through the slots to bite into it. So how well it feeds depends not only on how the dog moves but also on dog height, foot pressure and the fabric itself.

title: 第一条约束：机针在布里，布不能动
The first constraint: no feeding while the needle is in
points: 第 3 章算例：布厚 1.5 mm，针尖 101.7° 入布、258.3° 出布，在布中占 156.6°。
Chapter 3 example: 1.5 mm fabric, needle enters at 101.7° and leaves at 258.3°, in the fabric for 156.6°.
剩下约两百度是留给送布的全部时间。
The remaining two hundred degrees or so is all the time available for feeding.
机针在布中时布被推动：轻则线迹歪、针距不匀，重则机针撞梭尖而断。
Pushing the fabric with the needle in it bends the needle: crooked seams and uneven stitches, or a needle that hits the hook and breaks.
narration: 时间上，送布要受刺布的约束。第 3 章的算例里，布厚 1.5 毫米时，针尖在 101.7 度刺进布，在 258.3 度离开布，机针在布里占了主轴转角的 156.6 度。剩下的两百度左右，就是留给送布的全部时间。为什么这么严格？因为机针还在布里的时候布被推着走，机针就被带弯了：轻的线迹歪斜、针距不匀，重的机针撞上梭尖，啪一声断掉。这就是送布机构的第一条设计约束。大家记住 101.7 和 258.3 这两个数，后面算时序都要用。布越厚，针尖碰到布面越早，这一点到厚料那页再看。

In time, feeding is constrained by needle penetration. In the Chapter 3 example, with 1.5 mm fabric, the needle point enters at 101.7° and leaves at 258.3°, so the needle is in the fabric for 156.6° of shaft rotation. The remaining two hundred degrees or so is all the time there is for feeding. Why so strict? Because if the fabric is pushed while the needle is still in it, the needle gets bent: at best a crooked seam and uneven stitches, at worst the needle hits the hook point and snaps. That is the first design constraint on the feed. Remember 101.7 and 258.3 — we will use them for timing later. And the thicker the fabric, the earlier the needle meets its surface; we will come back to that on the heavy-material slide.

title: 结构：两条传动链合成一个运动
Structure: two drive trains, one motion
points: 水平：上轴送布偏心轮 → 送布连杆 → 针距调节器（导杆） → 送布摆轴 → 牙架前后动。
Horizontal: main-shaft feed eccentric → feed rod → stitch regulator (guide) → feed rock shaft → feed bar fore and aft.
竖直：下轴抬牙偏心轮 → 抬牙摆轴 → 叉臂托牙架上下动。
Vertical: hook-shaft lift eccentric → lift rock shaft → fork arm lifts the feed bar.
牙架两个运动叠加 = 送布牙运动。
The two motions of the feed bar add up to the dog’s motion.
好处：针距只改水平幅度，不影响升落时刻；牙高只改竖直位置，不影响针距。
Benefit: stitch length changes only the horizontal amplitude, not rise/drop timing; dog height changes only the vertical position, not stitch length.
narration: 送布牙要同时前后动、上下动，在算例机里这两个运动来自两条传动链，看图 6-1。绿色是水平链：上轴上的送布偏心轮带着送布连杆上下摆，连杆下端只能沿针距调节器的导杆滑动，再经拉杆传到送布摆轴，带着牙架前后走。黄色是抬牙链：下轴上的抬牙偏心轮推抬牙摆轴，摆轴的叉臂托着牙架一端上下动。送布牙用螺钉固定在牙架上，两个运动一叠加，就是牙的运动。这样分工有个好处：针距只改变水平运动的幅度，不影响牙什么时候升、什么时候落；牙高只改竖直位置，不影响针距。

The dog has to move fore-and-aft and up-and-down at the same time; in the worked-example machine those two motions come from two drive trains — see Fig. 6-1. Green is the horizontal train: the feed eccentric on the main shaft rocks the feed rod; the rod’s lower end can only slide along the guide of the stitch regulator, and a drag link passes the motion to the feed rock shaft, which moves the feed bar back and forth. Amber is the lift train: the lift eccentric on the hook shaft rocks the lift rock shaft, whose fork carries one end of the feed bar up and down. The dog is screwed to the feed bar, so the two motions add up to the dog’s motion. The division of labour has a benefit: stitch length changes only the horizontal amplitude, not when the dog rises or drops; dog height changes only the vertical position, not the stitch length.

title: 两个简谐运动与抓布区间
Two harmonic motions and the gripping interval
points: 偏心轮驱动的连杆输出接近简谐运动：X 水平（送布方向为正），Y 竖直（针板面为 0）。
Eccentric-driven links give nearly harmonic motion: X horizontal (feed direction positive), Y vertical (plate surface = 0).
S 水平行程，φ_F 最前端转角；A 抬牙幅值，h 牙高，φ_L 最高点转角。
S horizontal stroke, φ_F angle of the foremost point; A lift amplitude, h dog height, φ_L angle of the highest point.
Y > 0 时才抓布：半宽 α = arccos((A − h)/A)，抓布区间 2α。
The dog grips only while Y > 0: half-width α = arccos((A − h)/A), interval 2α.
Example h = 0.8 mm, A = 1.1 mm: α = 74.2°, interval 148.3°; φ_L = 40.0°, emerges 325.8°, drops 114.2°.
narration: 偏心轮带动的连杆输出接近简谐运动，所以牙齿尖的水平位置 X 和竖直位置 Y 都写成余弦。X 的幅值是半行程，在 φ_F 到最前端；Y 以针板面为零，A 是抬牙幅值，h 是牙最高时高出针板的高度，叫牙高。牙只有露出针板、Y 大于零的时候才抓得住布。令 Y 等于零，得到抓布区间半宽 α 等于 arccos((A−h)/A)。算例牙高 0.8、幅值 1.1，α 是 74.2 度，抓布区间 148.3 度。最高点放在 40 度，牙就在 325.8 度升出、114.2 度落下。为什么这么定，讲时序时揭晓。

A linkage driven by an eccentric gives nearly harmonic motion, so we write both the horizontal position X and the vertical position Y of the tooth tip as cosines. X has an amplitude of half the stroke and reaches its foremost point at φ_F. Y is measured from the plate surface; A is the lift amplitude and h is how far the teeth stand above the plate at the top — the dog height. The dog can grip only while it is above the plate, Y greater than zero. Set Y to zero and you get the half-width of the gripping interval: α equals arccos of (A minus h) over A. With a dog height of 0.8 and an amplitude of 1.1, α is 74.2° and the interval 148.3°. Put the highest point at 40°, and the dog emerges at 325.8° and drops at 114.2°. Why these angles? We will see when we get to timing.

title: 轨迹是倾斜椭圆；送布量小于行程
A tilted ellipse; feed is less than the stroke
points: 两分量相差 90° 时椭圆是正的；算例最高点比最前端早 74°，椭圆向右上倾斜。
With components 90° apart the ellipse is upright; in the example the highest point is 74° before the foremost, so it tilts up to the right.
布只在牙露出时跟着走：s = X(φ_L + α) − X(φ_L − α)。
The fabric follows only while the dog is up: s = X(φ_L + α) − X(φ_L − α).
最前端与落牙同时：s = (S/2)(1 − cos 2α) = 0.926 S；3 mm 针距要行程 3.24 mm。
With the foremost point at the drop: s = (S/2)(1 − cos 2α) = 0.926 S; a 3 mm stitch needs a 3.24 mm stroke.
针距刻度标的是布实际走的距离，不是牙的行程。
The stitch-length scale shows how far the fabric moves, not the dog stroke.
narration: 两个分量合起来，就是图 6-2 右边倾斜的椭圆。齿尖在针板上面从左往右走，推着布前进；落到针板下面再从右往左退回。第二点更重要：布走的距离不等于牙的行程。布只在牙露出针板的时候才跟着走，所以每针送布量是牙在升出和落下两个时刻的水平位置之差。算例中最前端正好和落牙同时，代进去得到 s 等于 S/2 乘 (1 − cos2α)，也就是 0.926 S。要缝 3 毫米的针距，牙得走 3.24 毫米。牙升出以前已经在针板下面往前走了一小段，那一段被“浪费”了。所以刻度盘上的针距，是布实际走的距离。

Combine the two components and you get the path on the right of Fig. 6-2: a tilted ellipse. Above the plate the tooth tip moves left to right, pushing the fabric; below the plate it returns right to left. The second point matters more: the fabric does not travel the full stroke. It follows the dog only while the dog is above the plate, so the feed per stitch is the difference between the dog’s horizontal positions at the moments it emerges and drops. In the example the foremost point coincides with the drop, and substituting gives s = S/2 times (1 − cos 2α), which is 0.926 S. To sew a 3 mm stitch the dog must travel 3.24 mm. Before it emerges, the dog has already moved forward a little below the plate, and that part is wasted. So the dial shows the distance the fabric really moves.

title: 相位差不对：回拖与拖针
Wrong phase: back-drag and needle drag
points: 水平单独提前 30°：牙在 84° 到最前端，114° 才落下，把布往回带 0.22 mm，实际针距只剩 2.17 mm——回拖。
Horizontal advanced 30°: foremost at 84°, drop at 114°, so the fabric is carried back 0.22 mm and the stitch shrinks to 2.17 mm — back-drag.
水平单独推迟 30°：牙落到针板面时还在往前走，布在机针入布后被推动。
Horizontal retarded 30°: the dog is still advancing as it reaches the plate, so the fabric is pushed after the needle enters.
前者针距变短、不匀；后者拖针。都靠偏心轮安装角调好。
The first shortens and unevens the stitch; the second drags the needle. Both are prevented by the eccentric mounting angles.
narration: 图 6-2 里还有两条虚线，是把水平运动单独提前或推迟 30 度的结果。提前的时候，牙在 84 度就到了最前端，可要到 114 度才落下，这三十度里牙已经开始往回走，把布往回带了 0.22 毫米，实际针距只剩 2.17 毫米，这叫回拖。这段往回走正好在机针刺布前后，针距就忽长忽短。推迟的时候反过来，牙已经落到针板面了还在往前推，布的移动拖到了机针入布以后，这就是拖针。两种情况都要靠把偏心轮的安装角调对来避免。实验里的“相位差”滑杆就是干这个的。

Fig. 6-2 also has two dashed curves: the horizontal motion alone advanced or retarded by 30°. Advanced, the dog reaches its foremost point at 84° but does not drop until 114°; during those thirty degrees it is already moving back and carries the fabric back 0.22 mm, leaving an actual stitch of only 2.17 mm. That is back-drag, and since it happens right around needle penetration the stitches go long and short. Retarded, it is the other way round: the dog is still pushing forward as it reaches the plate surface, so the fabric is still moving after the needle has entered — needle drag. Both are avoided by setting the eccentric mounting angles correctly. In the virtual lab, the phase-difference slider does exactly this.

title: 送布时序与标准定时
Feed timing and the standard setting
points: Needle in fabric 101.7°–258.3°; dog gripping 325.8°–114.2° (across 0°); they overlap only from 101.7° to 114.2°.
重叠时牙已接近最前端：101.7° 时布已走完 99%，此后只移动约 0.04 mm。
In the overlap the dog is near its foremost point: at 101.7° the fabric has done 99% of its travel and moves only about 0.04 mm more.
使用说明书的标准定时：牙落到针板以下时，牙面和针眼上沿同时与针板齐平——不用量角度。
The manual’s standard timing: as the dog drops, its face and the top of the needle eye become flush with the plate together — no angle measurement needed.
升牙一侧有六十多度余量，紧张的是落牙一侧；挑线 55° 收紧时布才走了约四分之三。
The rising side has over sixty degrees to spare; the drop side is critical. At the 55° take-up the fabric has done only about three-quarters of its travel.
narration: 把牙的运动和机针运动画在同一根转角轴上，就是图 6-3。灰色是机针在布中，101.7 到 258.3 度；绿色是牙抓布，325.8 度到下一圈的 114.2 度。两者只在 101.7 到 114.2 度重叠一小段，而这时牙已经快到最前端了，下半部分的布位置曲线显示，入布时布已经走完了 99%，后面只再动约 0.04 毫米。这个定时有出处：说明书规定，牙落下时牙面和针眼上沿同时与针板齐平。算例里针眼上沿正好在 114.2 度到针板面。好处是不用量角度，手转上轮看两者同时没入针板就行。

Put the dog motion and the needle motion on one angle axis and you get Fig. 6-3. Grey is the needle in the fabric, 101.7° to 258.3°; green is the dog gripping, from 325.8° round to 114.2°. They overlap only briefly, from 101.7° to 114.2°, and by then the dog is nearly at its foremost point: the fabric-position curve below shows 99% of the travel done when the needle enters, with only about 0.04 mm to go. This timing has a source: the manual says that as the dog drops below the plate, its face and the top of the needle eye should be flush with the plate at the same moment. In the example the top of the eye reaches the plate at exactly 114.2°. The beauty of it is that no angle is measured — turn the handwheel and watch them sink below the plate together.

title: 定时提前、推迟与厚料
Advancing and retarding the timing; heavy material
points: 说明书：防送布不匀可提前；要线迹收紧可推迟。本章简化为水平与抬牙一起移动。
Manual: advance to prevent uneven feeding, retard to tighten stitches. Here both motions are shifted together.
提前 10°：落牙 104.2°，布在针中几乎不动；推迟 10°：0.12 mm；推迟 20°：0.25 mm。
Advance 10°: drop at 104.2°, almost no movement in the needle; retard 10°: 0.12 mm; retard 20°: 0.25 mm.
四层牛仔约 4 mm：针尖 92.7° 入布，早 9°；标准定时下布在针中被推约 0.11 mm。
Four plies of denim, about 4 mm: needle enters at 92.7°, 9° earlier; with standard timing the fabric is pushed about 0.11 mm.
两者一起提前约 8° 降到 0.05 mm 以下；只提前水平 8° 还剩约 0.06 mm 且有回拖。
Advancing both by about 8° brings it below 0.05 mm; advancing only the horizontal 8° leaves about 0.06 mm plus back-drag.
narration: 说明书说：防送布不匀可把定时提前，要线迹收紧可推迟。我们把水平和抬牙一起移动叫送布定时。用时序图算：提前 10 度，落牙到 104.2 度，布在针中几乎不动；推迟 10 度，被推 0.12 毫米；推迟 20 度，0.25 毫米，这就是送布不匀和断针的来源。现在回到开头的牛仔腰头：四层约 4 毫米厚，针尖在 92.7 度就碰到布面，比薄料早了 9 度，按标准定时布在针中被推了约 0.11 毫米。两个运动一起提前约 8 度，就降到 0.05 以下。只提前水平运动不行，还剩 0.06，且有回拖。

The manual adds two sentences: to prevent uneven feeding, advance the feed timing; to tighten the stitches, retard it. We call shifting horizontal and lift together the feed timing. From the timing diagram: advance 10° and the drop moves to 104.2°, with almost no movement in the needle; retard 10° and the fabric is pushed 0.12 mm; retard 20°, 0.25 mm — that is where uneven feeding and broken needles come from. Now back to the waistband: four plies are about 4 mm thick, so the needle meets the surface at 92.7°, 9° earlier than thin fabric, and with standard timing the fabric is pushed about 0.11 mm. Advance both motions by about 8° and it drops below 0.05. Advancing only the horizontal motion is not enough: 0.06 remains, plus some back-drag.

title: 针距调节器与倒缝
The stitch regulator and reverse stitching
points: 连杆下端 C 被偏心轮带着上下走约 2e，又只能沿导杆滑动；导杆倾斜 θ，C 同时左右走 2e·tanθ。
Rod end C moves about 2e up and down and can only slide along the guide; with the guide tilted θ it also moves 2e·tanθ sideways.
θ = 0 针距为零；θ < 0 牙在针板上方往后走，就是倒缝；倒缝扳手把导杆推到另一侧。
θ = 0 gives zero stitch; θ < 0 makes the dog move back above the plate — reverse; the reverse lever pushes the guide across.
Example e = 3 mm, i = 1: s = 5.55 tanθ; 3 mm needs 28.4°, 5 mm needs 42.0°.
Each extra 1 mm needs 10.2°, 9.6°, 8.6°, 7.4°, 6.2°: the scale crowds towards long stitches.
narration: 针距调节器要做两件事：不停机连续改变针距，还要能倒缝。看图 6-4。送布连杆下端 C 被偏心轮带着上下走，行程约 2e，但它又被约束在一根导杆上，只能沿导杆滑。导杆竖直时 C 只上下动，没有水平分量，针距为零；导杆倾斜 θ，C 每上下一次就左右走 2e 乘 tanθ，经送布摆轴传给牙架。导杆倒向另一边，牙在针板上面往后走，就是倒缝；倒缝扳手干的就是这件事。算例 e 取 3 毫米，3 毫米针距要倾斜 28.4 度。因为 tanθ 越来越陡，刻度越往大针距越密，真实机器会加凸轮或杠杆修正。

The stitch regulator has two jobs: change the stitch length continuously without stopping, and make reverse stitching possible. Look at Fig. 6-4. The lower end C of the feed rod is moved up and down by the eccentric, a stroke of about 2e, but it is also constrained to a guide and can only slide along it. With the guide vertical, C moves only up and down, there is no horizontal component and the stitch length is zero. Tilt the guide by θ, and each up-and-down stroke also moves C sideways by 2e tanθ, which the rock shaft passes to the feed bar. Tip the guide the other way and the dog moves backward above the plate — reverse stitching; that is what the reverse lever does. With e = 3 mm, a 3 mm stitch needs 28.4°. Because tanθ steepens, the scale crowds towards long stitches, and real machines add a cam or lever to correct it.

title: 牙的速度与牙高
Dog speed and feed-dog height
points: 3 mm 针距、5000 r/min：最大速度 (S/2)ω ≈ 0.85 m/s，最大加速度 (S/2)ω² ≈ 444 m/s²。
3 mm stitch at 5000 r/min: maximum velocity (S/2)ω ≈ 0.85 m/s, maximum acceleration (S/2)ω² ≈ 444 m/s².
Dog height (manual): standard 0.75–0.85 mm, light 0.7–0.8, medium-heavy 0.95–1.05, heavy 1.0–1.1 mm.
Height 0.8 → 1.0 mm: interval 148.3° → 169.6°, rising 10.6° earlier and dropping 10.6° later.
结果：针距 3.00 → 3.11 mm，布在针中移动增加，回拖约 0.03 mm；调牙高后要复查定时和针距。
Result: stitch 3.00 → 3.11 mm, more movement in the needle, about 0.03 mm back-drag; recheck timing and stitch length after changing the height.
narration: 送布牙动得有多快？3 毫米针距、5000 转时，最大水平速度是半行程乘角速度，约 0.85 米每秒，最大加速度约 444 米每二次方秒，四十多个 g。好在那一小块布很轻，真正的限制是滑料压力不够时打滑。再看牙高。说明书按机型给牙高，薄料低不留牙痕，厚料高抓得住。但有个容易忽略的后果：抓布区间跟着变。牙高从 0.8 调到 1.0，区间从 148.3 度变成 169.6 度，牙提前 10.6 度升、推迟 10.6 度落，针距变成 3.11，还有一点回拖。所以调了牙高，一定复查定时和针距。

How fast does the dog move? At a 3 mm stitch and 5000 r/min the stroke is 3.24 mm; the maximum horizontal velocity is half the stroke times the angular speed, about 0.85 m/s, and the maximum acceleration about 444 m/s² — over forty g. Luckily the patch of fabric under the foot is light; the real limit is a slippery fabric slipping when the pressure is too low. Now dog height. The manual gives heights by model: low for light fabric so the teeth leave no marks, high for heavy fabric so they grip. But there is an easily overlooked consequence: the gripping interval changes. Raising the height from 0.8 to 1.0 widens the interval from 148.3° to 169.6°; the dog rises 10.6° earlier and drops 10.6° later, the stitch becomes 3.11 mm and a little back-drag appears. So after changing the height, always recheck timing and stitch length.

title: 牙的倾斜与压脚压力
Dog tilt and presser-foot pressure
points: 说明书以牙面水平为标准：前端抬高防起皱，前端降低防送布不匀（本章模型不含倾斜）。
The manual takes a level dog as standard: front raised against puckering, front lowered against uneven feeding (tilt not modelled here).
压力太小：摩擦不够，布跟不上牙，针距变短、忽长忽短——打滑。
Too little pressure: not enough friction, the fabric lags the dog, stitches short and irregular — slipping.
压力太大：留压痕，而且上层布被压脚拖住得更多。
Too much pressure: marks on the fabric, and the foot holds back the upper ply more.
压脚抬起高度（说明书膝控）：标准 10 mm，最大 13 mm，薄料型 9 mm。
Presser-foot lift (manual, knee lifter): standard 10 mm, up to 13 mm, light type 9 mm.
narration: 牙还可以倾斜。说明书以牙面水平为标准，把牙前端抬高可以防起皱，前端降低可以防送布不匀，本质上是重新分配牙前后两端的抓布力。我们的模型把牙面当水平，不算倾斜。压脚压力是牙能不能抓住布的另一半条件。压力太小，牙齿和布之间的摩擦拖不动布，布跟不上牙，针距变短、忽长忽短，这叫打滑。压力太大，布上留压痕，而且下一页会看到，压力越大，上层布被压脚拖住得越多。压脚抬起的高度也有规定，说明书里膝控抬压脚标准 10 毫米，最大 13 毫米，决定了能塞进多厚的布。

The dog can also be tilted. The manual takes a level face as standard: raise the front to prevent puckering, lower the front to prevent uneven feeding — in effect redistributing the gripping force between front and rear. Our model treats the face as level and ignores tilt. Presser-foot pressure is the other half of whether the dog can grip. Too little, and friction between teeth and fabric cannot drag the fabric: it lags the dog, the stitches are short and irregular — that is slipping. Too much, and the fabric is marked, and, as the next slide shows, the more pressure, the more the foot holds back the upper ply. The foot lift is specified too: with the knee lifter, 10 mm standard and up to 13 mm in the manual, which decides how thick a bundle fits under the foot.

title: 上层布为什么越缝越长
Why the upper ply grows longer
points: 下送布只有一只牙在下面：直接推下层；上层靠层间摩擦带着走，同时被压脚拖住。
Drop feed has one dog underneath: it pushes the lower ply; the upper ply rides on inter-ply friction while the foot holds it back.
一针少走 1%，缝 40 cm 就差 4 mm。
1% less per stitch means 4 mm over 40 cm.
示意模型：每针少走比例 ρ = μ_f P/K；不打滑要求 P ≥ P_min = F₀/(μ_d − μ_f)。
Illustrative model: shortfall ρ = μ_f P/K; no slipping needs P ≥ P_min = F₀/(μ_d − μ_f).
衬里两层：P_min = 0.8 时已多出 4.8 mm，超出 3 mm；压力越大越糟，1.4 以上还有压痕——下送布无可用区间。
Two plies of lining: at P_min = 0.8 the excess is already 4.8 mm, over 3 mm; more pressure is worse and above 1.4 marks appear — drop feed has no usable range.
narration: 现在讲第二个问题：上下两层是不是一起走。下送布只有一只牙，在布的下面，它直接推的是下层；上层要靠两层之间的摩擦被带着走，同时它的上表面被压脚压着、拖着，所以每一针都比下层少走一点点。一针少走百分之一，缝 40 厘米就差 4 毫米。教材用一个示意模型：每针少走的比例 ρ 等于压脚摩擦系数乘压力再除以面料抵抗变形的能力。另一方面压力又不能太小，否则打滑。这就是下送布的两难。看图 6-5 衬里两层：不打滑的最小压力 0.8，这时已经多出 4.8 毫米，超标了，下送布在这里根本没有可用区间。

Now the second question: do the two plies move together? Drop feed has one dog, under the fabric, and it pushes the lower ply directly. The upper ply has to be carried along by friction between the plies while its top surface is pressed and dragged by the foot, so every stitch it travels slightly less than the lower ply. One percent less per stitch is 4 mm over 40 cm. The book uses an illustrative model: the shortfall per stitch, ρ, equals the foot friction coefficient times the pressure divided by the fabric’s resistance to deformation. Yet the pressure cannot be too low, or the fabric slips. That is the dilemma of drop feed. Look at Fig. 6-5 for two plies of lining: the minimum pressure without slipping is 0.8, and there the excess is already 4.8 mm, over the limit. Drop feed simply has no usable range here.

title: 几种送布方式
Feed systems compared
points: 差动送布：针前针后两只牙行程不同，推挤或拉开同一层布（第 9 章），对层间错位帮助不大。
Differential feed: front and rear dogs with different strokes gather or stretch one ply (Chapter 9); little help with ply shift.
针送布：机针入布后随牙摆动，把两层“钉”在一起；定时与下送布相反，牙最高点约在 180°，抓布 105.8°–254.2°；错位降到约三成。
Needle feed: the needle swings with the dog after entering, pinning the plies; timing is the reverse of drop feed, dog highest near 180°, gripping 105.8°–254.2°; shift falls to about 30%.
综合送布：牙 + 针 + 交替压脚，上中下同时带走，错位降到约一成；用于皮革、箱包、汽车座椅。
Compound feed: dog + needle + alternating feet carry top, middle and bottom together; shift falls to about 10%; used for leather, luggage, car seats.
上送布：上方另设牙、滚轮或送布带，上下送布量可分别设定（绱袖机，第 29 章）；电子送布见第 14 章。
Top feed: a separate dog, roller or belt above, top and bottom amounts set independently (sleeve setter, Chapter 29); electronic feed in Chapter 14.
narration: 既然下送布有天生的两难，办法有两类：一类是把两层布钉在一起走，一类是给上层布也配一个主动送布。看图 6-6。差动送布管的是同一层布被拉长或起皱，对上下层错位帮助不大。针送布让机针也参加送布，机针入布以后跟着牙一起往前摆，两层被钉在一起。注意它的定时正好和下送布相反：要在机针入布以后才送布，算例牙最高点放在 180 度，抓布区间 105.8 到 254.2 度，正好落在机针在布中的区间里。综合送布再加一对交替升降的压脚，错位降到约一成。上送布则在上方单独设牙、滚轮或送布带。

Since drop feed has a built-in dilemma, there are two kinds of remedy: pin the plies together so they travel as one, or give the upper ply an active feed of its own. Look at Fig. 6-6. Differential feed deals with one ply being stretched or puckered and does little for shift between plies. Needle feed makes the needle join in: after entering, it swings forward with the dog, pinning the plies together. Note that its timing is the opposite of drop feed: it feeds only after the needle is in. In the example the dog’s highest point is at 180°, and the gripping interval, 105.8° to 254.2°, falls inside the needle-in-fabric interval. Compound feed adds a pair of alternately lifting feet and brings shift down to about a tenth. Top feed puts a separate dog, roller or belt above the fabric.

title: 模型的边界与现场要点
Limits of the model and shop-floor notes
points: 简谐近似忽略了高次谐波，轨迹不是严格椭圆；tanθ 只是原理，真实正倒缝针距略有差别。
The harmonic approximation ignores higher harmonics, so the path is not a strict ellipse; tanθ is only the principle, and real forward and reverse stitches differ slightly.
布被当作完全跟着牙走；错位和打滑模型是示意的，参数只能靠试缝确定。
The fabric is assumed to follow the dog perfectly; the ply-shift and slip models are illustrative, and parameters come only from test sewing.
查定时：手转上轮，看牙面与针眼上沿是否同时没入针板。换厚料同时考虑牙高、压力、定时。
Check timing by turning the handwheel: do the dog face and eye top sink below the plate together? For heavy material consider dog height, pressure and timing together.
上层变长先减压力，不行换针送、综合送或上送，不要靠操作工手拉补偿。
If the upper ply grows, first reduce pressure; otherwise use needle, compound or top feed — never rely on the operator pulling the fabric.
narration: 最后说模型的边界。我们把送布牙运动当成简谐运动，真实的偏心轮、连杆、摆轴会带来高次谐波，轨迹不是严格的椭圆；针距调节器的 tanθ 关系也只是原理，真实的连杆几何让正缝和倒缝的针距略有差别，所以有的机型设了倒缝微调。布被当成完全跟着牙走，没考虑牙齿咬入、布的弹性和惯性。错位和打滑模型更是示意的，摩擦系数和面料参数只是为了讲清两难，实际只能靠试缝。现场要点请记住：手转上轮查定时；换厚料三件事一起考虑；上层变长先减压力，不行换送布方式，千万别让操作工用手拉布来补。

Finally, the limits of the model. We treated the dog motion as harmonic; a real eccentric, link and rock shaft add higher harmonics, so the path is not a strict ellipse. The tanθ relation of the regulator is likewise just the principle; real linkage geometry makes forward and reverse stitches differ slightly, which is why some models have a reverse fine adjustment. The fabric was assumed to follow the dog perfectly, ignoring tooth bite, fabric elasticity and inertia. The ply-shift and slip models are even more illustrative: the friction coefficients and fabric parameters were chosen to show the dilemma, and real values only come from test sewing. Remember the shop-floor notes: check timing by turning the handwheel; for heavy material consider three things together; if the upper ply grows, reduce pressure first, then change the feed system — never make the operator pull the fabric by hand.

summary: 送布牙的运动是水平、竖直两个简谐运动的合成，轨迹是倾斜的椭圆；只有牙露出针板（抓布区间 2α，α = arccos((A − h)/A)）那一段才推动布。
The dog’s motion combines two harmonic motions into a tilted ellipse; only the part above the plate (interval 2α, α = arccos((A − h)/A)) moves the fabric.
每针送布量 s = X(落) − X(升)，最前端与落牙同时时 s = 0.926 S；针距刻度标的是布的实际移动。
Feed per stitch s = X(drop) − X(rise); with the foremost point at the drop, s = 0.926 S; the dial shows the fabric’s actual movement.
布只能在机针出布后移动：标准定时是牙面与针眼上沿同时没入针板；厚料机针入布早，要把送布定时（水平和抬牙一起）提前。
The fabric may move only while the needle is out: standard timing has the dog face and eye top sink below the plate together; heavy material needs the feed timing (both motions) advanced.
针距调节器 S = 2e·i·tanθ，导杆倒向另一侧即倒缝；牙高改变抓布区间，调后要复查定时和针距。
Stitch regulator S = 2e·i·tanθ, with reverse when the guide tips over; dog height changes the gripping interval, so recheck timing and stitch length.
下送布有“压力小打滑、压力大错位”的两难；针送布、综合送布、上送布从不同角度消除上下层错位。
Drop feed has the dilemma “too little pressure slips, too much shifts the plies”; needle, compound and top feed each remove ply shift in their own way.

title: 送布牙轨迹与送布时序
Feed-dog trajectory and feed timing
goal: 观察送布牙轨迹、送布时序与机针运动的关系，读出抓布区间。
Observe how the dog trajectory and feed timing relate to the needle motion, and read off the gripping interval.
学会用送布定时和相位差两个量消除拖针和回拖。
Learn to remove needle drag and back-drag with the feed timing and phase difference.
体会牙高、压脚压力、送布方式对打滑和上下层错位的影响。
See how dog height, foot pressure and feed system affect slipping and ply shift.
theory: 牙齿尖 X = (S/2)cos(φ − φ_F)，Y = (h − A) + A cos(φ − φ_L)；A = 1.1 mm，标准牙高 0.8 mm，标准定时下牙在 114.2° 落下（针眼上沿到达针板）。
Tooth tip X = (S/2)cos(φ − φ_F), Y = (h − A) + A cos(φ − φ_L); A = 1.1 mm, standard height 0.8 mm, standard drop at 114.2° (eye top at plate).

steps: 打开实验页，按“暂停”后拖动主轴转角滑杆，对照侧视动画、轨迹图和时序图，找出牙升出针板、落下和机针入布、出布的时刻。
Open the lab, press Pause and drag the shaft-angle slider; using the side view, trajectory and timing chart, find when the dog emerges and drops and when the needle enters and leaves.
保持棉布、下送布、针距 3 mm 的标准设定，记录读数区的实际针距、布在针中的移动量、回拖量和牙落下时针眼上沿的高度。
With the standard settings (cotton, drop feed, 3 mm), record the actual stitch, movement with the needle in, back-drag and eye-top height at the drop.

按“打乱定时”，先用“送布定时”滑杆把落牙时刻对到针眼上沿到达针板的时刻，再用“相位差”消除回拖，使各项读数达标（任务 2）。

Press “Scramble timing”; first use the feed-timing slider to make the drop coincide with the eye top reaching the plate, then use the phase difference to remove back-drag until all readings pass (Task 2).
面料选“牛仔四层”，下送布、针距 3 mm：观察布在针中的移动量；把送布定时提前，必要时调压力或牙高，再复查定时，直到不打滑、不留痕、移动和回拖都 ≤ 0.05 mm（任务 3）。

Choose four plies of denim, drop feed, 3 mm: note the movement with the needle in; advance the feed timing, adjust pressure or height if needed and recheck timing until there is no slip, no marks, and movement and back-drag are both ≤ 0.05 mm (Task 3).
只用“相位差”把水平运动单独提前 8°，记录结果，与送布定时提前 8° 比较。
Advance only the horizontal motion by 8° with the phase-difference slider, record the result and compare with advancing the feed timing by 8°.
面料选“衬里滑料两层”，在下送布上从小到大调压脚压力，记录打滑、错位和压痕的变化；再改用针送布、综合送布，使错位 ≤ 3 mm 且不打滑、不留痕（任务 4）。

Choose two plies of slippery lining; on drop feed, raise the foot pressure step by step and record slipping, shift and marks; then switch to needle and compound feed until shift ≤ 3 mm with no slip or marks (Task 4).

title: 送布机构计算与送布方式选择
Feed calculations and choosing a feed system
tasks: （推导与计算）证明当牙的最前端与落牙同时时，每针送布量 s = (S/2)(1 − cos 2α)。抬牙幅值 A = 1.1 mm，求牙高 0.8 mm 和 1.0 mm 时的抓布区间；牙高 0.8 mm 时要缝 4 mm 针距，牙的水平行程应为多少？

(Derivation and calculation) Show that when the dog’s foremost point coincides with the drop, s = (S/2)(1 − cos 2α). With A = 1.1 mm, find the gripping interval for dog heights of 0.8 mm and 1.0 mm; with 0.8 mm, what dog stroke is needed for a 4 mm stitch?
（计算）针距调节器 e = 3 mm、i = 1，送布效率按 0.926 计。求针距 2、3、4、5 mm 所需的导杆倾角，以及倒缝 2.5 mm 的倾角；说明刻度为什么越往大针距越密，主轴 5000 r/min、针距 4 mm 时牙的最大速度和加速度是多少？

(Calculation) Stitch regulator e = 3 mm, i = 1, efficiency 0.926. Find the guide tilt for 2, 3, 4 and 5 mm and for a 2.5 mm reverse stitch; explain why the scale crowds towards long stitches; and find the dog’s maximum velocity and acceleration for a 4 mm stitch at 5000 r/min.
（计算与实验）四层牛仔布厚 4 mm，用第 3 章公式（r = 15.5 mm、连杆 55 mm、针尖上止点高出针板 18 mm）求针尖入布角，说明按标准定时会出现什么问题、应当怎样调；在虚拟实验 6-1 中完成任务 3 并截图。

(Calculation and lab) Four plies of denim are 4 mm thick. Using the Chapter 3 formula (r = 15.5 mm, rod 55 mm, needle point 18 mm above the plate at TDC), find the needle-entry angle, explain what goes wrong with standard timing and how to correct it; complete Task 3 of Virtual lab 6-1 and take a screenshot.
（论述）一家女装厂缝两层真丝衬里，上层越缝越长。用 6.8 节的模型说明为什么单靠调压脚压力解决不了，比较针送布、综合送布、上送布各自怎样消除错位，给出你的设备建议和理由。

(Discussion) A womenswear factory sews two plies of silk lining and the upper ply keeps growing. Use the model of Section 6.8 to explain why foot pressure alone cannot solve it, compare how needle, compound and top feed remove the shift, and give your equipment recommendation with reasons.

text: 四动作送布中送布牙的动作顺序是：
The order of the dog’s motions in a four-motion feed is:
升起 → 前进 → 下降 → 退回
Rise → advance → drop → return
前进 → 升起 → 退回 → 下降
Advance → rise → return → drop
升起 → 退回 → 下降 → 前进
Rise → return → drop → advance
下降 → 前进 → 升起 → 退回
Drop → advance → rise → return

feedback: 先升起顶住布，在针板上方前进带布，再降到针板下，在下面退回不碰布。
It rises to grip, advances above the plate carrying the fabric, drops below the plate and returns underneath without touching it.

text: 送布牙在针板下面退回时，会把布往回带一段，所以实际针距小于牙的行程。
As the dog returns below the throat plate it carries the fabric back a little, which is why the stitch is shorter than the dog stroke.
feedback: 在针板下面退回不碰布。针距小于行程，是因为牙在升出针板以前已经在下面往前走了一段，那一段没有带布。
The return below the plate does not touch the fabric. The stitch is shorter because the dog has already moved forward a little below the plate before emerging, and that part carries nothing.

text: 抬牙幅值 A = 1.1 mm，牙高 h = 0.9 mm。用 α = arccos((A − h)/A) 求牙露出针板的抓布区间 2α（度）。
Lift amplitude A = 1.1 mm, dog height h = 0.9 mm. Using α = arccos((A − h)/A), find the gripping interval 2α in degrees.
feedback: α = arccos(0.2/1.1) = 79.5°, so 2α ≈ 159.0°, between 148.3° (0.8 mm) and 169.6° (1.0 mm). Giving only α yields 79.5°.

text: 算例机的送布效率 s/S = 0.926（最前端与落牙同时、牙高 0.8 mm）。要缝 3.5 mm 的针距，牙的水平行程应为多少 mm？
In the worked example the feed efficiency s/S = 0.926 (foremost point at the drop, dog height 0.8 mm). What dog stroke is needed for a 3.5 mm stitch?
feedback: S = s/0.926 = 3.5/0.9256 ≈ 3.78 mm. Multiplying by 0.926 instead (3.24 mm) reverses the relation.

text: 使用说明书给出的标准送布定时，现场怎样检查最方便？
How is the manual’s standard feed timing most conveniently checked on the shop floor?
手转上轮，看送布牙落下时牙面和针眼上沿是否同时与针板齐平
Turn the handwheel and see whether, as the dog drops, its face and the top of the needle eye become flush with the plate together
用分度盘量送布偏心轮相对针杆曲柄的角度是否为 90°
Measure with a protractor whether the feed eccentric is 90° from the needle-bar crank
看针杆在上止点时送布牙是否在最高点
Check that the dog is at its highest point when the needle bar is at top dead centre
缝一段线迹量针距，与刻度一致即定时正确
Sew a seam and measure the stitch; if it matches the dial the timing is right

feedback: 这条规定不需要量角度：算例中针眼上沿和落牙都在 114.2°。针距与刻度一致并不能说明布没有在针中被推动。
The rule needs no angle measurement: in the example both the eye top and the drop are at 114.2°. A matching stitch length does not prove the fabric is not pushed with the needle in.

text: 针距调节器 e = 3 mm、i = 1，送布效率 0.926，s = 0.926 × 2e·i·tanθ。缝 4 mm 针距时导杆倾角 θ 是多少度？
Stitch regulator e = 3 mm, i = 1, efficiency 0.926, s = 0.926 × 2e·i·tanθ. What guide tilt θ gives a 4 mm stitch?
feedback: tanθ = 4/(0.926 × 6) = 0.720, θ ≈ 35.8°. Ignoring the efficiency gives 33.7°.

text: 把牙高从 0.8 mm 调到 1.0 mm（其余不变），按本章模型会发生哪些变化？
If the dog height is raised from 0.8 mm to 1.0 mm (all else unchanged), what happens according to this chapter’s model?
抓布区间从 148.3° 变宽到 169.6°
The gripping interval widens from 148.3° to 169.6°
实际针距从 3.00 mm 增加到约 3.11 mm
The actual stitch grows from 3.00 mm to about 3.11 mm
落牙推迟，布在针中被推动的量增加，并出现少量回拖
The drop is later, the movement with the needle in increases and a little back-drag appears
针距和定时都不受影响，因为牙高只改竖直位置
Neither stitch length nor timing changes, because height only shifts the vertical position
牙落下提前 10.6°，拖针减轻
The dog drops 10.6° earlier and needle drag is reduced

feedback: 牙高改变 Y = 0 的交点，牙提前 10.6° 升出、推迟 10.6° 落下，所以针距、拖针、回拖都变了，调后要复查定时和针距。
Height moves the Y = 0 crossings: the dog emerges 10.6° earlier and drops 10.6° later, so stitch length, drag and back-drag all change; recheck timing and stitch length.

text: 针送布的定时与下送布相比：
Compared with drop feed, the timing of needle feed is:
正好相反：机针入布以后才送布，牙的最高点放在机针最低点附近
Opposite: it feeds only after the needle has entered, with the dog’s highest point near the needle’s lowest
相同：都要求布在机针离开布料以后才移动
The same: both require the fabric to move only after the needle has left
针送布不需要送布牙，只靠机针摆动
Needle feed needs no dog; only the needle swings
针送布在钩线 206° 时停止送布，与旋梭无关
Needle feed stops at the 206° catch and has nothing to do with the hook

feedback: 针送布靠机针把两层钉住一起走，所以要在机针入布后送布；算例牙最高点 180°，抓布 105.8°–254.2°。206° 钩线时机针正在摆动，旋梭要专门设计。
Needle feed pins the plies with the needle, so it feeds after entry: highest point at 180°, gripping 105.8°–254.2°. At the 206° catch the needle is swinging, so the hook needs special design.

text: 针距 3 mm（牙行程 3.24 mm）、主轴 4000 r/min，牙的水平运动按简谐运动计算，最大水平速度是多少 m/s？
Stitch length 3 mm (dog stroke 3.24 mm), main shaft 4000 r/min, harmonic horizontal motion. What is the dog’s maximum horizontal velocity in m/s?
feedback: ω = 2π × 4000/60 = 418.9 rad/s; v = (S/2)ω = 1.62 mm × 418.9 ≈ 0.68 m/s. Using the full instead of half stroke gives 1.36 m/s.

text: 把送布的水平运动相对抬牙单独提前 30°（落牙仍在 114°），会出现：
Advancing only the horizontal feed motion by 30° relative to the lift (drop still at 114°) causes:
回拖：牙在 84° 已到最前端，此后在针板上方往回带布，针距缩短到约 2.17 mm
Back-drag: the dog is foremost at 84° and then carries the fabric back above the plate; the stitch shrinks to about 2.17 mm
针距变长，因为牙更早开始前进
A longer stitch, because the dog starts advancing earlier
布在机针入布后才开始移动
The fabric starts moving only after the needle enters
打滑，因为压脚压力相对变小
Slipping, because the foot pressure becomes relatively lower

feedback: 最前端早于落牙 30°，这 30° 里牙已后退，带回约 0.22 mm。推迟水平运动才会使布在机针入布后还被推动。

The foremost point is 30° before the drop, and during those 30° the dog moves back, carrying the fabric back about 0.22 mm. Retarding the horizontal motion is what pushes the fabric after needle entry.

text: 针距 3 mm（牙行程 3.24 mm）、主轴 4000 r/min，按简谐运动求送布牙的最大水平加速度（m/s²）。
Stitch 3 mm (dog stroke 3.24 mm), main shaft 4000 r/min. Assuming harmonic motion, find the dog’s maximum horizontal acceleration in m/s².
示意模型 ρ = μ_f P/K。衬里两层取 μ_f = 0.15、K = 10，压脚压力为标准值 P = 1.0，下送布缝 40 cm，上层比下层多出多少 mm？
Illustrative model ρ = μ_f P/K. For two plies of lining take μ_f = 0.15, K = 10, standard pressure P = 1.0. On drop feed, how many mm does the upper ply gain over a 40 cm seam?
feedback: ρ = 0.15 × 1.0/10 = 1.5%，400 mm × 1.5% = 6.0 mm，远超 3 mm 的允许值；压力降到不打滑的下限 0.8 也还有 4.8 mm。
ρ = 0.15 × 1.0/10 = 1.5%; 400 mm × 1.5% = 6.0 mm, well over the 3 mm allowance; even at the slip limit P = 0.8 it is still 4.8 mm.

text: 下列哪些送布方式能直接减小两层布之间的错位？
Which feed systems directly reduce shift between two plies?
针送布
Needle feed
综合送布（牙 + 针 + 交替压脚）
Compound feed (dog + needle + alternating feet)
上送布（上方另设牙、滚轮或送布带）
Top feed (a separate dog, roller or belt above)
差动送布
Differential feed

feedback: 前三种或把两层钉在一起走，或给上层主动送布。差动送布前后两只牙都在下面，处理的是同一层布的拉长或起皱。
The first three either pin the plies together or drive the upper ply actively. Differential feed has both dogs below and deals with stretching or puckering of a single ply.

text: 四层牛仔（4 mm）上，标准定时下布在针中被推约 0.11 mm。若只把送布定时（水平和抬牙一起）提前 4°，按本章模型结果是：
On four plies of denim (4 mm), standard timing pushes the fabric about 0.11 mm with the needle in. If the feed timing (both motions) is advanced by only 4°, the model gives:
约 0.075 mm，仍超过 0.05 mm，需要提前约 8°
About 0.075 mm, still above 0.05 mm; about 8° is needed
降为 0，因为落牙已早于针尖入布
Zero, because the drop now precedes needle entry
增大到约 0.2 mm
It rises to about 0.2 mm
约 0.045 mm，已经合格
About 0.045 mm, already acceptable

feedback: 提前 4° 落牙在 110.2°，仍比 92.7° 入布晚很多，移动量约 0.075 mm；提前 8° 才降到约 0.045 mm。
Advancing 4° puts the drop at 110.2°, still well after entry at 92.7°, leaving about 0.075 mm; it takes about 8° to reach about 0.045 mm.

text: 缝四层牛仔时，只把送布的水平运动单独提前 8°，与把水平和抬牙一起提前 8° 效果相同。
On four plies of denim, advancing only the horizontal feed motion by 8° works as well as advancing horizontal and lift together by 8°.
feedback: 只提前水平时落牙仍在 114.2°，布在针中还移动约 0.06 mm，并出现少量回拖；一起提前时落牙提前，移动降到约 0.045 mm。
With only the horizontal advanced the drop stays at 114.2°, leaving about 0.06 mm of movement and a little back-drag; advancing both brings the drop forward and the movement to about 0.045 mm.

key: 两个简谐运动的合成、抓布区间与送布效率；送布时序与标准定时；针距调节器原理。
